notes.title: The Chain Mode Update Has Arrived!
notes.content:
[p][b]What’s up Climbers![/b][/p][p]Crowbar Boy here, and it’s time to break the chains… because the long-awaited [b]Chain Mode Update[/b] is LIVE! [/p][h1][b]⛓️New Mode: Chain Mode[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/553b6cbc336e38d44039193a8d9f707479191cf5.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Multiplayer CO-OP Stage! Prison Breakout[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/cc0be3e4018d4ce1d60bfe105c72880f85de9aac.png"][/img]The prison break is ON! Team up with one other player as you climb while chained together, scaling high-security walls, dodging deadly laser traps, and outsmarting the towering Prison Guard Crowbar Boy.[/p][p]Every step brings you closer to freedom… but will the chains help you, or hold you back?  Do you have what it takes to reach the summit and break free?[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]🧗New Skins[/b][/h2][h3][b]⛓️ Convict Climber Skin[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/1ca9c0ce9226e5fbcd4f5e267ac415a6860bee03.png"][/img]Dirty, rugged, and fueled by defiance. The Convict Climber has nothing left to lose and everything to prove. With rusted crowbars and grit-stained hands, he claws his way toward freedom one desperate pull at a time.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🚽 Skibidi Boy Skin[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/3bbf7b15a3d34f907ce2f935bb1ef31bd2316407.png"][/img]Chained, flushed, and utterly unhinged. Skibidi Boy drags his porcelain prison up the walls with desperate determination, clanging chains and all. Each swing is a frantic attempt, each climb a last-ditch effort to escape![/p][p]Grab your gear, trust your partner, and fight your way to freedom in this chaotic new co-op mode![/p][p][/p][h2][b]💬 Join The Official Discord[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/d68b24371ae90d09c50c148db50acb61252f4bb7.png"][/img][/p][h3][url="https://discord.com/invite/bazookastudio"][b]Join our Discord to share your fastest escapes, find climbing partners, and give feedback on this brand-new game mode.[/b][/url]
[/h3][p][b]Thanks for playing Crowbar Climber![/b][/p]

notes.title: POWER Up Your Climb! New Climber Challenge: POWER Stage!
notes.content: [p]What’s up Climbers![/p][p]Crowbar Boy here, and it’s time to push your limits… because the new [b]Climber Challenge: POWER[/b] stage is LIVE! 💪[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/07e83377e3f5a01e02837072edf1f7e4dc83915a.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]🌟 New Stage: Climber Challenge POWER![/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/ce280c4a750bf7588f9ea50b3178db16efe0fb6a.png"][/img]This is a brand-new type of stage for solo players who want to test their strength and stamina. The Climber Challenge [b]POWER[/b] will push your arms, endurance, and determination to the max![/p][h2][b]⏰10 Levels of Challenge![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/33abd2524bdf05bf2b945536df6bd4581b7ca601.png"][/img]Each level requires more strength to reach the top. Can you conquer [b]Level 10[/b] and set your personal best time?  [/p][p][/p][h2][b]🧗‍♀️Fall Recovery![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/ce4e2f87857cb7ea0776c561fa708c0c30bb9dd8.png"][/img][/p][p]Don’t worry if you fall! You’ll restart from the same level you fell on, so every attempt counts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/54b5859be7774a7d9c99537164bc8dcab394e8de.gif"][/img][/p][p]Are you ready to see how fast you can reach the summit? Only the strongest climbers will survive! Grab your gear, tighten your grip, and take on the ultimate solo climbing challenge.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/d68b24371ae90d09c50c148db50acb61252f4bb7.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/bazookastudio"]Join our Discord[/url] to share your fastest climbs in [b]The Crowbar Climber[/b] channel and let us know what you think of the new stage![/p][p][b]Thanks for playing Crowbar Climber![/b][/p]

notes.title: Samurai Showdown Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
[p]What’s up Climbers![/p][p]Crowbar Boy here, and things just got [i]deadly serious[/i] at the summit... because the [b]Samurai Showdown Update is LIVE![/b] 🥷[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcKLNuVWKb0RwR-19U1surhlyte_DYwmIrgq0THU2lv5zptIwJG_POdPsPPWs0i0td2-9UEf-CPgqcekeUxA0KeOnnn9sDolObQuWk9l7ZOwJJ3x6lZxT_DeJmfI4bUdzBrsFLbmg?key=wDL1JcfJFwGodQ96SrPL_w"][/img][/p][h2]🌟 [b]New Stage: Dojo Dash![/b][/h2][p][b][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdZo00R_9QxJpLZOmQqAfpcGPux11JRvJd1LwU5prRnSWa-Vp0aupg4wLSo3PH2uWJSM9fNUPmO3wApfAdFpN0LNIyOAgc-Rs6stPWZP_VfrA724XX6ilup6OLqVQvgcgXUlbzxUA?key=wDL1JcfJFwGodQ96SrPL_w"][/img][/b][/p][p]War has come to multiplayer and this isn’t just another climb, it’s a battlefield! With fresh textures and crazy new gimmicks, Dojo Dash will have you screaming, laughing, and begging for just one more race.[/p][p]Race up with up to 7 other climbers as you scale towering Japanese dojo walls, dodge shuriken-throwing ninjas, and leap through mighty Torii gates

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/aac4606cfbaeae30b52aa0ef2f72c91a3727e700.gif"][/img][/p][p]Do you have what it takes to seize the summit and be crowned Summit Shogun?[/p][p]
[/p][h2]🥷[b] New Skins[/b][/h2][p]Two legendary warriors have joined the war:[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfn9WlV6_t52lDUcg9uBjBvPLo750KesdLY9dfWUUI85Flmx9UaHWb1QDjJqKpuV7qYK5amWe2VO_IajNPBG9LIKBQelE2XGN8Wn3Jj6_PI11bIoX3XKDbAXZ4e1cDiEQ1WRafRAw?key=wDL1JcfJFwGodQ96SrPL_w"][/img][/p][h3]🥷 [b]Shadow Ninja Skin:[/b][/h3][p]Silent as night, swift as the wind. The Shadow Ninja’s every move is precise and lethal! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdexqqOB-4Lco1guGnBfmsnK_i5qogw9j-Y617UdOWcFVVUXmzYGVPEQrwguTO9zARjmXllnq6zyChKFdHrYqQmYwpMfOkQHqIJr7h8AMXPKMmCexsxzzz8Cwedc_JkVLjVII50Xw?key=wDL1JcfJFwGodQ96SrPL_w"][/img][/p][h3]⚔️ [b]Iron Samurai Skin: [/b][/h3][p]Fearless, disciplined, and bound by honor. The Iron Samurai treats every climb as a duel, conquering the summit with unshakable resolve and warrior’s pride.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]🔧 [b]Other Improvements[/b][/h2][p][b][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfKnW201wcfjiSfwjCx02EbKBTiZBHI3MIrhG3djVIwKx40hEpvh6cF9L1QpjbXpQrBgkAaVhqqKW3A-TD8NoJ6RwDsitIBe-dP10NBAtTc8m6_tEko5lyaTD47aeS0X45L-8oI?key=wDL1JcfJFwGodQ96SrPL_w"][/img][/b][/p][p]We’ve added a mirror so you can see yourself when changing skins. We adjusted matchmaking so players can’t join Rooms after a race has started. And we added a switch for Private Room hosts to turn their lobby into a Random Room! This way after gathering friends, you can still open the doors for new challengers!

[/p][p]Grab your gear, sharpen your focus, and get ready for the most intense Summit War yet.[/p][p][/p][h2][url="https://discord.com/invite/bazookastudio"]Join our Discord to share your climbs, enter giveaways, and hear the latest updates first![/url][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Thanks for playing Crowbar Climber![/b][/p]

notes.title: Multiplayer gets a major upgrade in the Summit Wars update!
notes.content:
[p]What’s up Climbers![b]
[/b]Crowbar Boy here with our wildest and most chaotic update yet! [b]Summit Wars: Wild Derby[/b] is LIVE! 🦍🦈🦅[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdozZ07DmeA_L8GtwiHlLij1jrpBMdUKWb5iJ7U5INEa4wlsEnC8Y1rG0N5UKERBqii4zy5VdhF2wI50JOjAwJq-E3oNhSqLdkkGE26d4x4JyyuAyTSiSfyURfykYqY_OnYFW_5Eg?key=hhNfL8pFHtRtPA2zvVKNgg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]🌟 Multiplayer gets a major upgrade![/b][/h1][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdZCqij9bovjsoN8LgMSS1CMWDlCUnKOkohT93oyH82G3mYuaImKCED0J5ehApE63bLAko-96lznrn3wp5CYy0LMF0vMiW-menw14L2MT8tLrjNjb91zWcvjpwB1pLzckqoNngwrQ?key=hhNfL8pFHtRtPA2zvVKNgg"][/img][b]
[/b]Get ready for the ultimate test of climbing skill and speed in [b]Wild Derby[/b], our brand-new race stage that supports up to [b]8 players[/b]! This stage is divided into three unique zones inspired by our newest animal champions: the land-hardened gorilla, the slick sea-dwelling shark, and the high-flying hawk. Will you lead the pack, or be left in the dust? The climb to the crown begins now![/p][p][/p][h1][b]🧢 New Skins Incoming![/b][/h1][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcKIcTCauC_x872dQBPJrdxJtvIp8w_xNG0Lt59XFmhQeQAt69E0PGkIpwDo7_rqyrKGXT31eITGA5qN_HvQEac-jpTFWTDewXCNygZncVDWTzQ-3JmPO_aFIiEmxHtRk9sRW-P?key=hhNfL8pFHtRtPA2zvVKNgg"][/img]You can now grab all three brand-new animal-themed skins in the [b]Beast Kings Bundle[/b]! Inspired by the rulers of land, sea, and sky, these skins are packed with wild charm and custom crowbars for each animal. Let’s take a look:[/p][p][/p][h1][b]🦈 King Shark Skin[/b][/h1][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcV60FLq3jqA1SQi3w3-Vi3LzmYeaU8Pt5TYqojIXAWMl0C0wqiNPUcQt39HxdBCSpldlAChth1nG0J4ygbw7LU90cNVlukOkxSyflK78Cm4dGnKeydrkp7OFTizD8nGhCVPOLD?key=hhNfL8pFHtRtPA2zvVKNgg"][/img]Leave the others in your wake. This champion of the sea has an insatiable appetite for speed! Armed with fishing poles instead of crowbars, the King Shark climbs with slippery style and ruthless energy. Sleek, hungry, and always on the hunt for victory, the King Shark dominates the depths and surfaces to snatch the crown.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]🦅 King Hawk Skin[/b][/h1][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfrnNHp3Dqefr_ZuftHaS-UwJ4rOoFLOrRWmUvFXc0JfdAObonJDPt-ElXjecLcw1SG--7jZLsxeSlOfsCHJbP2SwgLPJllDS6spIWCt0oKFkceATJbamxM_6DWQffgh3tMhyvhiw?key=hhNfL8pFHtRtPA2zvVKNgg"][/img]Rule the skies with grace and precision. The King Hawk’s lightweight, high-altitude style is all about strategy and swooping past the competition. Equipped with birdhouse-topped poles, this aerial ace watches the race unfold from above until it's time to dive in and steal the win.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]🦍 King Gorilla Skin[/b][/h1][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf-UK9w6XmsbQVfh2haBCQbxaFIhJKUheY2RHp8z4M621KPgo_fwYVPU5W2J2osinQKhT2yaIqauZL8TE4_VeSHRyHLh3u93CqValFoGAeTCKnsZi-Esw_dCFcNpLpwhW1K10SsJQ?key=hhNfL8pFHtRtPA2zvVKNgg"][/img]Power, pride, and bananas. The King Gorilla brings brute strength and jungle swagger to the climb, smashing through obstacles with banana-tipped sticks. Every swing is heavy, every grab deliberate! This beast rules the land with unstoppable momentum and bold flair.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Whether you rule the Sky, Sea, or Land, there’s only one spot at the top. Grab the [b]Beast Kings Bundle[/b] and stake your claim in the [b]Summit War[/b]![/p][p]Don’t forget to share your beastly climbs on [b]Discord[/b]![/p][p][/p][h3][url="https://discord.com/invite/bazookastudio"]Join our Discord here for faster announcements, giveaways, and more![/url][/h3][h3]Thanks for playing [b]Crowbar Climber[/b]![/h3]

notes.title: Climb Race Update: The 1v1 Race To The Top Begins On Zenith Sprint!
notes.content: [p]What’s up Climbers! [/p][p]Crowbar Boy here to tell you about the latest update! I just released an all-new [b]Race Mode[/b], and with it comes a brand new [b]free stage[/b]: [b]Zenith Sprint[/b]! Challenge a friend, pick your path, and race your way to victory![/p][h1][b]What’s New in the Climb Race Update:[/b][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdvfoXmlwmxMrfqCyWzcrrKYRYE5tTPxIoG2a9-mbIn-PUg1Acp7kZP-THlEGf9EjnQvOuiWdzribCi0i87mYwdXESwLli-cP55QHZ8tdbLYGT7UR0mvigMcIM_rUeOpeU9yvhDDg?key=_ec4mPajkbiP5ujm40CTMQ"][/img][/h1][h2][b]🏁New Mode: Race Mode[/b][/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcTxf4L2GrjzztFSblDUurZBaVrV3DlU3wRKmjEIPwlliSB9tc9bynTGaOHY0EZAyEri4YC6PUDoFKSZaSIAn2Wfd6Hhq7QkRnnNeX_6dUKJbuA2KAuGlY2WH4EarUC0DX1U5WOow?key=_ec4mPajkbiP5ujm40CTMQ"][/img][/p][p]Now you can race head-to-head in a brand-new competitive mode! Two players climb the same course, each taking their own route to the top. But don’t get too comfortable! This is a true test of speed [i]and[/i] strategy![/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Free Stage: Zenith Sprint![/b][/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeSkCFeIQixlWXGO57bc6e1L9Lafjix6B6ljU9CKf2kMQjLmszeSrhN3CMmvJdwjWAC8DEqPafLkMvxmwKmgV9xvLmSbgoXWhMvcHYdWidLoS9Z9jw2srV1j9UDzLNG0q5putHA5A?key=_ec4mPajkbiP5ujm40CTMQ"][/img]Welcome to [b]Zenith Sprint[/b], the first-ever [b]race stage[/b] in Crowbar Climber! Players choose between two unique paths:[/p][list][*][p]🔴 [b]Red Route:[/b] Faster, but riskier. Only for the bold.[/p][/*][*][p]🔵 [b]Blue Route:[/b] Safer and steadier. Better for thoughtful climbers.[/p][/*][/list][p]Each path offers a different challenge. Which one will you choose?[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🐢🐇New Skins: The Tortoise and the Hare Bundle![/b][/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcnYKIThGiIO4AV5sanhKvc8KifTu2kS6_se3QDepJxbzOR8Rc5bY7hiLTq1ZnsoyPFYL3yb1E7Sz-0HpUSUGWAgUYSo9OUayZaP7KSHC-9V4FAKJL1a6R4StwsRrNEVJHXsLisNA?key=_ec4mPajkbiP5ujm40CTMQ"][/img][/p][p]Grab this fairytale bundle including:[/p][list][*][p]🐇 [b]Hare Skin:[/b] For speed demons who live on the edge.[/p][/*][*][p]🐢 [b]Tortoise Skin:[/b] For patient climbers who know slow and steady can still win. [/p][/*][/list][p]In the fable, the tortoise wins…but in [b]Crowbar Climber[/b], anything can happen. Available for a [b]limited time only![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for playing Crowbar Climber! [/b]See you at the top![/p]

notes.title: [NEW STAGE] Bullet Time!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/85d9ec665d962678c38a3d7406c6bfd3148b6dfb.png[/img]
What’s up Climbers!  
Crowbar Boy here to tell you about the latest update!  

I just released a new stage, [b]Bullet Time[/b], for my fellow climbers, and it's available to play NOW!  

[h2]WHAT’S NEW: Bullet Time Stage!!  [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/7dee56c284a52d5868e6b94f00926cc9f22e39ca.png[/img]
Everything is moving [b]in slow motion[/b], but your frustration might speed up!  


My new Bullet Time stage slows everything down to [b]1/4 speed![/b]
Your movements, the windmills, the levers, [b]everything![/b]
You'll need to be extra precise with your jumps and time your swings perfectly to make it through. Can you keep your cool and conquer this challenge, or will slow motion drive you up the wall?  

I hope you enjoy this new stage!  

See you at the top!  
Crowbar Boy OUT!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259275/aadfef13ed196f5702cd7004c49bf8aabeb0be4e.gif[/img]

notes.title: BRAND NEW STAGE!!
notes.content:
Hello Crowbar Climbers!

I’ve been so excited to make this announcement, I could hardly wait!!
Today, we’ve added a BRAND NEW STAGE to the game! And it’s completely free!!!
It’s been about two months since the game’s release, and I’m so grateful that so many climbers are enjoying it. 

Have you had the chance to see the view from the top yet?

As long as you keep playing, I’ll keep working on updates.
Thank you so much for all your support! It means the world to me.

I’m deeply moved by the fact that so many people have chosen to spend their precious time and money playing this game. Reading your reviews on the store and seeing your comments on TikTok truly makes me happy.
Please enjoy the new stage!

notes.title: Small Update & New Stage Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello, Crowbar Climbers!
I have a small update this week as well!

I’ve enhanced the streaming mode on Steam for added convenience!
You can now customize your view on PC by pressing the 4 key for first-person view only, or the 5 key for third-person view only. Be sure to give it a try!

And guess what?
Next week, I'm releasing the long-awaited new stage update! Yay!! I'm working hard to finish it up, so please hang tight for just a little longer!
Let me know what you think about this update and the game in your reviews! Reviews are the greatest reward for game developers like me.

See you at the top!

notes.title: Random Match Mode Added!
notes.content:
Hello Crowbar Climbers!
How’s everyone enjoying the multiplayer mode I introduced last week?
I’m also hard at work developing new stages, so please hang tight a little longer!

By the way, I’ve noticed some of you saying, “I wish I could play with climbers I don’t know!”
You’re absolutely right—aiming for the top can be just as exciting with strangers as it is with friends!

So, I’ve added a **"Random Match Mode!"** 

Simply join an online room and press the **"Join Random Room"** to team up with other climbers who are also looking for partners to conquer the heights with!

Give it a try!
And don’t forget to let me know what you think about this update and the game itself in your reviews!

See you at the top!

notes.title: Multiplayer Mode Unlocked!
notes.content:
Hello Crowbar Climbers!
I’m so happy to share a big update with you all today!

By far the most requested feature [b]—Multiplayer Mode—[/b] has just been added to the game!
The climb to the top doesn’t have to be a lonely journey anymore. Now you can climb together with a friend!
